text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
We're here at the Arima Kinen, the final
race of this year's Twinkle
Series, and the
star of the show is the Triple Crown
champion, Narita Brian!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
We didn't get our wish to see her take on
her sister, Biwa Hayahide,
but she's ready
to race for the two of them!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
However, it's also her first mix-up with
racers in the senior year!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Against these top-class veterans, can she
win her fifth G1 race and
become a Five
Crown champion?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Good, looks like you're focused even in a
huge race like this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't know how long I can keep steady
though. My whole body's
aching to run.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide's not here today, so that means
all your opponents will be
going after you.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide's not here today, so that means
all your opponents will be
going after you.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But knowing you, that won't be a problem.
Go blow everyone away
with some crazy
running!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But knowing you, that won't be a problem.
Go blow everyone away
with some crazy
running!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to tell me twice. They'll
find no mercy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... You made it after all,
Narita Brian!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Only the toughest of the tough race in the
Arima Kinen. But I've got
my eyes on you
alone.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And you better know it's 'cause I think
you're the best! So don't you
dare back
out of our race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Like I would. You're on, Ama. Give me
everything you've got.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I hope you're ready to have some fun!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The racers are waiting in the gate.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Will the Triple Crown champion, Narita
Brian, win? Or will another racer finally
stop her? Get ready to find out as the
Arima Kinen...
begins!
